note: Rolling wooded and grassland hills northwest of Bethany with small fishing ponds. One primitive camping area at the west entrance off Route F: a short gravel loop with a few pull-in spurs just south of the parking lot. --Claude
summary: Confirmed: page 'Camping: Individual Campsites', Rule 140 standard; brochure 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map'; map (05/15) one Primitive Camping Area symbol beside the west lot = GIS 243, imagery a small gravel loop with ~4 spurs. Free/FCFS/no hookups/14 nights manual. PIN under trees beside the spurs: nudge to 40.32395,-94.12379. Not waterfront kept. Phone matches.
flags: INCLUSION/FIT: area page 'Camping: Individual Campsites'; Rule 140 standard text, no special-use-permit rule. Brochure: 'Primitive camping is permitted only in areas identified on area map.' Map (05/15) legend 'Primitive Camping Area'; one symbol, beside the Parking Lot at the west entrance (Route F side) = GIS 243. Imagery: a gravel turnaround loop ~60 m long running south from lot 699, with about four short gravel pull-in spurs on its west side under a tree line; a 23-ft rig fits the loop and the spurs look ~10-12 m deep. Designated camp beside a lot, not a ramp lot: stays. No horse camp, ford or rig wording.
PIN: stored 40.32408,-94.12390 = GIS 243, under the trees just west of the spurs. Nudge onto the camp loop: 40.32395,-94.12379.
CLUSTERS / NO SPLIT: one camping area.
WATERFRONT (not waterfront, kept): Pond 1 is ~350 m north (map scale) across grassland and is a small pond; no water at the camp.
PHONE: area page 'For more information call (660) 646-6122' matches stored.
